Sam (Finance): vendor lumen-data reports invoice 3417 shows ~900k tokens fewer than their ingest logs for 2026-04-05 midnight window. Can we investigate?
Dani (Data Eng): which window exactly?
Sam (Finance): 2026-04-05 00:00-00:30 UTC. Lumen's export shows 5.2M; our metering shows 4.3M.
Cam (Billing): gap ~900k tokens -> est $54. Any deployments around that time?
Dani (Data Eng): checking deploys... we rolled tokenizer-v2 to ingestion fleet at 2026-04-05T00:05Z with opt-in flag. There's a rollback at 00:20 for a separate patch. Could be hybrid tokenization causing undercount for CJK payloads.
infra-oncall: infra logs show mixed tokenizer versions active between 00:05-00:22. Some messages tokenized by v1, some by v2. v2 uses wordpiece packing that reduces token count for certain languages.
Sam (Finance): if v2 produced fewer billable tokens, client could be underbilled. We need decision: do we backfill to normalize to legacy tokenization or leave as-is?
Dani (Data Eng): options: 1) recompute tokens for affected messages using v1 tokenizer (replay from archive) to match historical billing semantics; or 2) accept v2 counts going forward and note the reduction as migration delta. Recompute estimate: ~90-120 mins, needs platform approval and billing sign-off. Risk: replay may not perfectly map if messages were normalized at ingestion (we archive raw payloads though).
Cam (Billing): recommend recompute for 1 billing period only to keep invoices consistent with prior billing baseline. Approve provisional credit hold until recompute completes.
Sam (Finance): approved provisional hold for up to $60 while we reprocess. Dani please run idempotent replay and post final delta.
Dani (Data Eng): SQL to find candidates:
```
select msg_id, tenant, tokens_v1, tokens_v2
from tokenizer_audit
where ts >= '2026-04-05T00:00:00Z' and ts < '2026-04-05T00:30:00Z' and tenant='lumen-data';
```
tokenizer-bot: audit-snapshot created s3://metering-audit/lumen/2026-04-05/tokenizer-migration-snapshot.csv ticket=INC-2026-412
infra-oncall: I'll freeze rolling changes to tokenizer flags until migration validation is done.
Sam (Finance): created BILL-ADJ-623 and linked INC-2026-412. Tagging @Dani to post final numbers when replay finishes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
